# PR 237 round 2: PASS WITH NOTES

Head: `f62e59ba315e02351a34055dfe5b635782d17481`

Final round under C34. Reviewed only the six-file delta between these heads.
Both of this reviewer's round-1 P2 findings are fixed. The live-holder
retirement fix for S237-001 is also correct. No remaining blocker or new
normal-use correctness bug was found in the delta. No third round requested.

## Fix verification

| Finding | Disposition | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Prime-role laundering / S237-002 | Fixed | `crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs:568-580` reads the orchestration designation, requires `PrimeState::Current` and matches its seat to the resolved caller. An asserted role no longer authorizes takeover. |
| Failed-probe native holder returns session-hold | Fixed | `crates/daemon/src/registration.rs:1846-1858` checks `holders.unknown` before the native session-hold branch, returning `PaneHeld` without mutation. |
| S237-001: explicit takeover retires a running foreign holder | Fixed | `crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs:623-650` checks every other holder first and collects candidates separately. An `Active` result refuses before the tombstone loop begins. Existing guarded tombstones still reject changed snapshots. |

The extended takeover regression first proves that a self-asserted prime
without designation is refused with holders unchanged, then uses a real
`designate_prime` for the successful case. Its final block uses an authorized
own-process caller against a live foreign child and verifies the child row,
the other candidate holders and the child's queued job remain unchanged.

The extended native-holder regression injects a liveness adapter error for a
different native Copilot session and checks `PaneHeld` names the incumbent
and leaves its descriptor unchanged. It would fail with the round-1 ordering.

CLI help and the two changed operational documents agree with the narrower
explicit takeover behavior. The banner placeholder is unchanged and remains
the author's non-blocking choice; it is not reopened here.

## Cost and policy

The added live-holder check is a **brake**: removing it can only retire more
records. The automatic Dead/Recycled retirement policy is unchanged.
There is no new steady-state loop, poll, timer or launch site (zero periodic
launches per second). Preflight liveness observations scale with the other
live rows on the target pane, once per explicit takeover, not per tick or
per fleet seat. Existing in-process liveness and its recorded fallback are
reused. No deployment or live-fleet before/after measurement was performed.
